## What Jospeed Does
Joseph Onifade builds production-ready web applications, AI-powered tools, and
automation pipelines for startups and businesses. His work spans:

- Full-stack web applications using React, TypeScript, Supabase, and Node.js
- AI chatbots and voice agents built with Voiceflow, Vapi, and the OpenAI API
- Workflow automation pipelines using n8n (self-hosted and cloud)
- No-code and low-code applications in Lovable, Bubble, Adalo, and FlutterFlow
- 3D and interactive web experiences with Three.js and Blender

## Core Tech Stack
React, TypeScript, Supabase, PostgreSQL, Node.js, Vite, Tailwind CSS,
n8n, Voiceflow, Vapi, OpenAI API, Anthropic API, Three.js, Blender,
Lovable, Bubble, FlutterFlow, Vercel, Netlify, GitHub
